steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed (or the scheduled service was done).
Switch the ignition to position I without starting the engine. On keyless cars, press START briefly without touching the brake.
Press and hold the OK button on the end of the left steering-column stalk.
Keep holding it and switch the ignition to position II. On keyless cars, hold START for about 2 to 3 seconds, still without the brake.
Keep holding OK for about 10 seconds until the information light starts to flash, then let go. A chime confirms the reset.
Switch the ignition off and leave it off for at least 3 minutes so the car's modules shut down normally.
oil.note: If the message does not clear, repeat the steps while holding the RESET button on the same stalk together with OK; repair technicians report that OK alone does not always work.

tpms.when: 2016 with tire pressure sensors in the wheels
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire placard on the driver's door pillar, checking each one with a gauge.
If you have to inflate warm tires, Volvo says you may need to add slightly more than the cold figure (about 3 to 4 psi) for the warning to clear, then recheck when the tires are cold.
Drive for several minutes at 20 mph (30 km/h) or faster. The warning text clears and the light goes out on its own; there is no reset button.
tpms.note: Some cars instead have Tire monitoring under MY CAR, Settings, Car settings. If yours shows Calibrate tire pressure there, choose it after setting the pressures and drive away; it finishes while driving and gives no confirmation. If the light stays on after driving, a tire may still be low or a sensor may be faulty; have it checked.
